https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides a platform for automated cloud-based development and testing environments, enabling developers and teams to create, manage, and scale isolated environments efficiently.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create isolated development or testing environments on demand.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with version control systems like Git for automated environment setup.
Users must be able to manage and monitor active environments, including starting, stopping, and deleting them.
Users must be able to collaborate by sharing environment access with team members or stakeholders.
Users must be able to configure environment specifications, such as CPU, memory, and software dependencies, to meet project requirements.
Users must be notified of the status of their environment creation, updates, or any errors encountered during the process.
The platform must ensure environments are secure and isolated to prevent interference or data breaches between projects.
